items.question: Where can I get new lightbulbs for the office? HEW
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“Where can I get new lightbulbs for the office? HEW”，自然应答是“Check with someone in maintenance.”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：C（Check with someone in maintenance.）。
